title: As someone who has seen Masquerade [redacted] amount of times, it was...
transcript: A new show is taking over the immersive Phantom Space for a limited time. It is called Starcadia, and the experience is essentially broken up into two parts. You start in the Lake Bar, which is the post show area for masquerade, and eventually you'll see people with lights on their hands moving throughout the space. You come to find out that these are called the Star People, each representing a different planet. The Star People then lead you upstairs for the pre show experience, where you can interact directly with the Star People and participate in a series of activities, whether that is hearing a story from earth, listening to a dream with Neptune, or playing ring toss with Uranus. This was definitely the most fun part of the entire experience. But then it is time to go into the theatre itself. If you have a VIP Ticket, which is designated by a glow ring necklace, you are invited into the theatre first to experience an exclusive scene. You'll also get first pick of seats. Then once everyone is let into the theatre, it is time for the show itself to start. The rest of the show is just done in a traditional in the round staging as we watch a meeting of the star people discussing what to do about earth, where humans are creating so much beautiful art, but at the same time destroying the planet. The show itself is quite stunning to look at. Although I did find it hard to follow at times, but at only 60 minutes, it is pretty short. And there was enough cool imagery to keep me engaged. This was a workshop presentation, so they have time to fine tune the storytelling. But I do think the bones are definitely there, and the storytelling is quite ambitious, so I am excited to see how the show continues to evolve from here.
